description: R06-B Interactivity Win32 reconciliation. UiaTextRangeTests exercises the retained Windows UI Automation COM provider boundary, so its complete Microsoft source surface remains deliberately Platform-only rather than being imitated in portable Rust.

sourceRules.notes: All 19 source methods exercise Microsoft::Console::Interactivity::Win32::UiaTextRange through Windows UI Automation/COM interfaces, WRL providers, TextPatternRangeEndpoint/TextUnit values, VARIANT attributes, scrolling through IRenderData, and the native TextBuffer/provider bridge. Migration policy retains native WinRT/COM/Win32 boundaries explicitly; no portable Rust shadow implementation is created merely to reduce ledger debt.
